name: runtime-legacy-seam-sweep
title: Sweep remaining dead runtime legacy seams
description: Remove the remaining dead prompt-hint, backend-only page snapshot alias, and frontend streaming back-projection seams that survived the mainline closeouts.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 post-closeout audit found three remaining bounded seams: page no-progress recovery still carried a dead first tuple slot and unused `render_contract` parameter; prompt contract registry still registered an unreferenced `page_flow_recovery` template; page-runtime backend internals still kept `ui_read_page` / `ui_read_surface` alias support even though live seeds/spec/frontend/runtime all standardized on `ui_get_snapshot`; frontend chat-input utils still carried an unreferenced `moveStreamingContentToThinking()` helper from the old thinking back-projection path. This sweep removed those dead seams, kept machine-readable recovery diagnostics as the only live owner, froze `ui_get_snapshot` as the single live snapshot contract, and deleted the unused frontend helper while preserving canonical turn-flow and persisted-history fallbacks. Verified with `ruff check backend/app/ai/engine/page_flow_recovery_helpers.py backend/app/ai/engine/tool_loop_session.py backend/app/ai/engine/tool_call_loop_policy.py backend/app/ai/engine/tool_call_loop_runtime.py backend/app/ai/prompt_contracts/loader.py backend/app/ai/tools/page_runtime backend/app/ai/tools/sandbox.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_page_flow_recovery.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_tool_loop_session.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_tool_call_loop_runtime.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_tool_call_loop_callbacks_factory.py backend/tests/ai/test_tool_sandbox_runtime_context.py backend/tests/ai/tools/page_runtime/test_definitions.py`, `pytest backend/tests/ai/engine/test_page_flow_recovery.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_tool_loop_session.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_tool_call_loop_runtime.py backend/tests/ai/engine/test_tool_call_loop_callbacks_factory.py backend/tests/ai/test_tool_sandbox_runtime_context.py backend/tests/ai/tools/page_runtime/test_definitions.py -q`, `pnpm --dir frontend exec eslint apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/chat-input-utils.ts apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/__tests__/chat-input-utils.test.ts`, and `pnpm --dir frontend exec vitest run apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/__tests__/chat-input-utils.test.ts apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/__tests__/use-ai-chat.test.ts`.
